name: [🎃] Avataria Life
desc:
✨ Welcome to Avataria Life ✨

Create your characters, decorate your home, and bring your own stories to life! Discover a colorful world where you choose how to play.

🎨 Customize your characters and choose their colors
🏡 Decorate your home with furniture and everyday items
🧸 Arrange, move, and stack objects to create your perfect space
👋 Invite friends over or meet other players in the public Park
💎 Earn Gems while you play

Join our Avataria Life Community — https://www.roblox.com/communities/641107200

❤️ Thanks for Your Support! ❤️
